enabled.description: Turn the advisor on. Needs an "advisor" model_roles entry to actually run.

every_n_turns.description: Review only every Nth finished turn instead of every one. 1 (default) reviews every turn.

min_severity.description: Lowest severity (NIT / CONCERN / BLOCKER) that raises a notification. Every severity is still queued for the next prompt either way.

auto_escalate.description: Run a deeper second pass (the "escalate" model role

escalate_threshold.description: Lowest severity (NIT / CONCERN / BLOCKER) that triggers auto_escalate.

trailer_style.description: Style of attribution trailer to add to commits

generated_with.description: Add Generated with Atlas-Agent line to commit messages and issues and PRs

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for the ls tool

max_items.description: Maximum number of items to return for the ls tool

models.description: Model configurations for different model types

hooks.description: User-defined shell commands that fire on hook events (e.g. PreToolUse)

env.description: Environment variables to set on startup

name.description: Friendly display name shown in the TUI for this hook

matcher.description: Regex pattern tested against the tool name. Empty means match all tools.

command.description: Shell command to execute when the hook fires

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the hook command

disabled.description: Whether this LSP server is disabled

command.description: Command to execute for the LSP server

args.description: Arguments to pass to the LSP server command

env.description: Environment variables to set to the LSP server command

filetypes.description: File types this LSP server handles

root_markers.description: Files or directories that indicate the project root

init_options.description: Initialization options passed to the LSP server during initialize request

options.description: LSP server-specific settings passed during initialization

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for LSP server initialization

command.description: Command to execute for stdio MCP servers

env.description: Environment variables to set for the MCP server

args.description: Arguments to pass to the MCP server command

url.description: URL for HTTP or SSE MCP servers

disabled.description: Whether this MCP server is disabled

disabled_tools.description: List of tools from this MCP server to disable

enabled_tools.description: Allow list of tools from this MCP server

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for MCP server connections

sessionless.description: Mark a sessionless MCP server (no Mcp-Session-Id) so Atlas-Agent skips the subscriptions/listen stream it would otherwise reject. Leave unset to auto-detect known sessionless servers (e.g. GitHub MCP)

headers.description: HTTP headers for HTTP/SSE MCP servers

oauth.description: Enable OAuth 2.1 authorization flow for this MCP server (HTTP transport only)

oauth_client_id.description: Pre-registered OAuth client ID for servers without dynamic client registration

oauth_client_secret.description: Pre-registered OAuth client secret paired with oauth_client_id

oauth_callback_port.description: Fixed localhost port for the OAuth callback

project_limit.description: Character limit for the project memory store (MEMORY.md). Negative means unbounded.

user_limit.description: Character limit for the user profile store (USER.md). Negative means unbounded.

context_paths.description: Paths to files containing context information for the AI

global_context_paths.description: Paths to files containing global context information for the AI

skills_paths.description: Paths to directories containing Agent Skills (folders with SKILL.md files)

subagents_paths.description: Paths to directories containing subagent definitions (name.md files with a model role)

debug_lsp.description: Enable debug logging for LSP servers

max_session_cost.description: Refuse a new prompt once a session's accumulated cost (USD) reaches this. Zero or unset means unbounded.

allowed_domains.description: If set, the only domains (and their subdomains) the fetch/download tools may reach

blocked_domains.description: Domains (and their subdomains) the fetch/download tools may never reach, checked before allowed_domains

auto_summarize_at.description: Summarize once this fraction of the context window is used (0-1 exclusive). Unset keeps the built-in thresholds.

max_provider_retries.description: How many times to retry a failed provider request. Unset keeps the default; 0 disables retries.

max_concurrent_subagents.description: Cap how many agent-tool sub-agents run at the same time. Zero or unset means no limit.

restrict_writes_to_working_dir.description: Refuse writes outside the working directory outright

max_download_bytes.description: Refuse a download larger than this many bytes. Zero or unset means no limit.

allowed_commands.description: Commands to lift from the bash tool's built-in block list (their subcommand blocks are lifted too)

blocked_commands.description: Extra commands the bash tool may never run - on top of the built-in block list

max_steps_per_turn.description: Stop a turn once it has taken this many model/tool-call steps, whether or not it is making progress. Zero or unset means unbounded.

tool_timeout.description: Stop a single tool call after this many seconds and tell the model it timed out. Zero or unset means unbounded.

data_directory.description: Directory for storing application data. Relative paths are resolved against the working directory; absolute paths are used as-is.

disabled_tools.description: List of built-in tools to disable and hide from the agent

disable_provider_auto_update.description: Disable providers auto-update. Atlas Agent ships an embedded provider catalog and uses it by default; enable this flag to opt out and use the catalog as-is

disable_default_providers.description: Ignore all default/embedded providers. When enabled, providers must be fully specified in the config file with base_url, models, and api_key - no merging with defaults occurs

initialize_as.description: Name of the context file to create/update during project initialization

auto_lsp.description: Automatically setup LSPs based on root markers

progress.description: Show indeterminate progress updates during long operations

notifications.description: Notification style to use. Options: auto (default), native, osc, bell, disabled. Auto selects based on environment: native for local sessions, osc for SSH (with automatic OSC 99/777 detection).

disabled_skills.description: List of skill names to disable and hide from the agent

memory.description: Bounds on the prose the agent carries between sessions

agent_models.description: Override which model type (large or small) an agent uses, keyed by agent id

model_fallbacks.description: Alternate provider/model pairs to fail over to, in order, when a model role hits a 429/rate-limit response

fallback_cooldown.description: How many seconds a fallback model stays active after a failover before the next turn returns to the primary model. Zero resets every turn.

model_roles.description: Named model roles a subagent's model field can reference by name, e.g. "frontend" or "research". A few names are recognized by built-in features when present: advisor, escalate, and compact (used to summarize with a different model than the session's own).

session_mode.description: Name of the mode whose instructions are folded into the main session's system prompt, e.g. review or security. A model role of the same name also switches the session's model. Empty runs the ordinary coder prompt.

advisor.description: A second model that reviews each turn and can leave a note for the next one. Needs a "advisor" entry in model_roles to run on.

sandbox.description: Contain shell-spawned processes in an OS-level container. Currently Windows only (Job Objects); a no-op elsewhere.

allowed_tools.description: List of tools that don't require permission prompts

base_url.description: Base URL for the provider's API

type.description: Provider type that determines the API format

api_key.description: API key for authentication with the provider

api_keys.description: Additional API keys for this provider (separate accounts/subscriptions), rotated round-robin across sessions

oauth.description: OAuth2 token for authentication with the provider

system_prompt_prefix.description: Custom prefix to add to system prompts for this provider

extra_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to send with requests

extra_body.description: Additional fields to include in request bodies, only works with openai-compatible providers

provider_options.description: Additional provider-specific options for this provider

aws_auth_refresh.description: Shell command to run when AWS credentials expire (Bedrock only).

discover_models.description: Auto-discover models from /v1/models endpoint. When true with existing models they are merged (yours win)

models.description: List of models available from this provider

enabled.description: Turn on Job Object containment for shell-spawned processes. Windows only for now -- inert elsewhere. This bounds process lifetime and count/memory; it does not restrict filesystem or network access.

max_processes.description: Cap on concurrently active processes inside the container (a fork-bomb ceiling). 0 uses a generous default.

max_memory_mb.description: Memory ceiling (MB) for any single contained process. 0 means unlimited.

model.description: The model ID as used by the provider API

provider.description: The model provider ID that matches a key in the providers config

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level for OpenAI models that support it

think.description: Enable thinking mode for Anthropic models that support reasoning

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens for model responses

presence_penalty.description: Presence penalty to increase topic diversity

provider_options.description: Additional provider-specific options for the model

compact_mode.description: Enable compact mode for the TUI interface

diff_mode.description: Diff mode for the TUI interface

transparent.description: Enable transparent background for the TUI interface

box_corners.description: Corner style for framed surfaces such as the composer and the landing cards. Leave unset to let Atlas-Agent pick based on the terminal it is running in. Which styles render depends on the terminal font: a font missing a glyph draws a replacement box in its place. 'rounded' needs U+256D-U+2570 and 'arc' needs U+25DC-U+25DF, both of which some fonts omit; 'sharp', 'bold' and 'double' come from the widely-supported Box Drawing block.

exit_banner.description: Exit banner style after quitting Atlas-Agent

max_output_length.description: Maximum width of the output the bash tool returns before its middle is dropped

auto_background_after.description: Seconds a command may run in the foreground before it becomes a background job

enabled.description: Turn on the browser tool so the agent can navigate / click / type / screenshot / run JavaScript in a real Chrome or Chromium instance. Requires a Chrome or Chromium install on PATH (or executable_path below).

executable_path.description: Path to a Chrome or Chromium binary. Empty auto-detects an installed browser.

headless.description: Run the browser without a visible window

use_real_profile.description: Browse as you: copies your own Chrome profile - cookies

real_profile_pin.description: Which Chrome profile use_real_profile copies when you have several. Empty copies the one you browsed with last - pin it if you do not want the profile you last touched deciding who the agent acts as.

user_data_dir.description: Chrome profile directory to launch with. Cookies and logins written here survive between sessions

remote_url.description: DevTools endpoint to drive a long-lived browser through (for example http://127.0.0.1:9222). If nothing is listening there Atlas starts one itself using user_data_dir and executable_path; that browser keeps running after Atlas exits so its logins and tabs survive. Attach to a Chrome you started yourself by giving it the same port. Chrome refuses remote debugging on your everyday profile so this is always a separate one - sign into it once and it stays signed in.

action_timeout.description: How long a single browser action (navigate / click / eval / etc.) may run before it is aborted

idle_timeout.description: How long an unused browser session is kept open before it is closed automatically

enabled.description: Turn on the Go static-analysis tools (dead_code and friends) so the agent can find unreferenced declarations and other structural facts without compiling the tree.
Turn on the debugger tool so the agent can launch a Go program under Delve: set breakpoints / step / inspect variables. Requires a Delve (dlv) install on PATH (or dlv_path below).

dlv_path.description: Path to the dlv binary. Empty uses dlv on PATH.

action_timeout.description: How long a single debugger request (set breakpoints / step / evaluate / etc.) may run before it is aborted. Does not bound continue -- that waits for the program to actually stop.

enabled.description: Turn on the documentation tools (doc_index and friends) so the agent can index and search a tree's Markdown files by heading.
Turn on the read-only git tools (git_status and friends) so the agent can inspect the working tree and history without shelling out.

timeout.description: Timeout for the glob tool call
Timeout for the grep tool call

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for the ls tool

max_items.description: Maximum number of items to return for the ls tool

enabled.description: Turn on the code-quality and security tools (scan_secrets and friends) so the agent can check a tree for leaked credentials and other quality problems.
Turn on team_send / team_read so sub-agents spawned by the same task can broadcast short notes to each other while still running.

default_read_limit.description: Lines the view tool returns when the model does not say

max_line_length.description: How much of a single long line survives before it is cut

hash_anchors.description: Show a short content hash next to every line so edit can target a line by number instead of reproducing its exact text. Off by default: it adds a few characters to every line view returns in exchange for cheaper and more reliable single-line edits.
